scope: Supplemental pixel questions for the agent-authored baseline; these do not become requester locks or automatic hard gates. Exact effective gates will be derived from the audited pack and actual optional selection.

focus.criterion: The loose hat ribbon, held fold, needle-to-stitch thread and travel setting form one understandable practical pause.
Visible facial contours and chin-length dark bob remain guided by the supplied image, without asserting identity.
Moss twill belongs to jacket, ivory rib knit to inner top, rust pleats to skirt rather than bleeding across carriers.
The rolled cuff shows a local turned inner region at the wrist with a coherent outer sleeve continuation; illumination alone is not construction evidence.
The narrow diagonal strap connects shoulder route to walnut bag through assessable brass attachments; a floating strap or unlabeled hardware is insufficient.
Exactly the intended needle-to-thread-to-new-stitch chain is assessable; small unobservable endpoint detail is failure to prove, not pass.
Held ribbon stays at the crown while free tail can lift in breeze; material response has local carriers.
Subject presence and purposeful action lead; harbor supports rather than overwhelms the moment.

pixel_rule: Assess from the actual first saved native image; partial or unobservable consequential relations cannot be promoted to pass. Preserve defects without repair rendering.
